evidence.quote:
remember returns a receipt in
seconds

observations.why: Ratifying a contract that specifies a fast receipt and watched extraction appeals to craft-quality (competence) and keeping the system stable and lossless (conservation).
The explicit appeal to no lost work is a conservation value — preserving what was done, keeping the system safe from data loss.

evidence.quote:
the agent either polls the run or
gets the reaction piggybacked on a later call

observations.why: Framing the agent's choice to poll or receive piggybacked results appeals to self-origination of action (autonomy) and mastery of the mechanism (competence).
